description: verifyAgentForCheckout vectors. input: agent_did (already verified from the request signature), cart, merchant_policy, agent (registry facts), mandate, key_state (approval-2.0 key_states), status, approval {approval, verifier_did, request_id}, now. expect: decision, reasons (in order) and, where an approval was offered and refused, the approval error in evidence.approval_error. Security bands rank poor < fair < good < strong.
warning: PUBLISHED THROWAWAY KEYS FOR TEST VECTORS ONLY. Every secret is published (test-vectors/approval-2.0/keys.json and test-vectors/keys.json). Anyone can sign with them. Never use them for anything real.
